name: Kuthiran Tunnel
facts: Kuthiran Tunnel, Kerala's first six‑lane road tunnel, opened its first tube on 31 July 2021 after a decade of construction, dramatically cutting travel time between Kochi and Coimbatore.
The twin‑tube tunnel stretches almost one kilometer, with the left tube measuring 955 m and the right 944 m, and features 14‑metre width and 10‑metre height for smooth traffic flow.

During the 2018 Kerala floods, emergency vehicles used the tunnel to bypass blocked roads, and in 2020 a gridlock caused by an accident was temporarily relieved by opening the under‑construction tube.
